note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its order-of-documents clause and the annexes are generic placeholders, never real contract text. The connectors are plain relations ("listed in this position"), never causes; the order shown is only the supplied order list — no interpretation doctrine, no conflict rule, no document prevails beyond its supplied position, no jurisdiction. "Priority document (as supplied)" and "Subordinate document, as configured" have equal visual weight. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): definitions, elements and relationships (the elements are the annexes, the relationships are fixed as "listed in position k"); clauses = the supplied order-of-documents clause, schedules = the annexes, priorities = the supplied order list.
